players.name: Michael Penix
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ribs) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Penix left the Oct 11 overtime loss to Baltimore late in the game with a rib injury, and Tua Tagovailoa finished it. On Oct 12 Schefter reported the injury is not considered serious and there is optimism he plays Week 6 vs CHI, but Atlanta will watch him practice before deciding.

players.name: Lamar Jackson

players.name: Caleb Williams

players.name: Tyler Shough
players.note: Shough played through a left (non-throwing) hand injury in the Oct 11 23-13 loss to Minnesota, with two fingers braced together. Afterward he would not say whether the hand is broken, so his status is worth watching this week.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (groin) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Took over Houston's backfield after Montgomery's groin injury on Oct 11, with 15 carries for 62 yards and 4 catches for 23 yards. FantasyPros and Rotoballer (Oct 12-13) call him a must-start RB1 while Montgomery is out.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (foot) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (ankle) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: With TreVeyon Henderson out multiple weeks with a high-ankle sprain from Oct 11, Stevenson becomes New England's lead back. Yahoo and PFN (Oct 12-13) call him a safe RB2 for Week 6 against the Jets.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (lower leg) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Was seen in a walking boot after the Oct 11 loss to the Jets with an ankle/foot injury, and is considered day-to-day. His Week 6 status against Baltimore is in doubt. Backup Raheim Sanders also left with a hip injury.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (toe) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: With Kyle Monangai out week-to-week with turf toe (ruled out Oct 9, still out heading into Week 6), Swift is expected to handle most of Chicago's carries, with Roschon Johnson as the change-of-pace back.

players.name: Ollie Gordon
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Went to the medical tent with an undisclosed injury during the Oct 11 game against Cincinnati after 17 carries as Miami's clear lead back, and reportedly returned to the game shortly after. Miami has its Week 6 bye.

players.name: CeeDee Lamb
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Left the Week 5 loss to Tampa Bay late on Oct 11 with a quad bruise that took a second hit in that game. Rapoport reported it is not believed to be serious, but he is questionable for Week 6 at Green Bay on Oct 18 (Forbes and other outlets, Oct 13).

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: With CeeDee Lamb questionable for Week 6 (quad), analysts expect Dallas's passing game to run through Pickens if Lamb sits (Oct 13). Pickens scored a TD in Week 5.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Hurt his ankle in the Oct 11 loss to the 49ers and was listed as limited on the estimated injury reports for Oct 12 and Oct 13. Analysts still expect him to play Thursday (Oct 15) at Denver.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Led the Eagles with 8 targets (5-63) in Week 5 on Oct 11 with DeVonta Smith out. His role shrinks if Smith returns in Week 6.

players.name: Deebo Samuel
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (hamstring) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Suffered a hamstring injury in the Oct 11 win over Seattle and was ruled out of that game. Shanahan said he will miss 'at least a couple of weeks' pending an MRI, so he is unlikely for Week 6 vs. Washington.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (shoulder - ac joint) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (hamstring) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Inactive for Week 5 on Oct 11 with a hamstring injury, his first missed game of the season. Minnesota has a Week 6 bye, so his next chance to play is Oct 25 vs. the Colts.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Eligible to come off IR (high ankle sprain) for Week 6 vs. the Jets. On Oct 12 Vrabel said there is 'a chance' he returns, and Pelissero reported he is pushing hard, but he must practice first and the team hadn't decided whether he would.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14. Earlier: Canales said Oct 12 that Coker (quad) is 'on track' for Week 6 at Philadelphia, and said Oct 13 that he 'looked great' in practice. His status is still TBD after he missed Week 4 and Carolina had a Week 5 bye.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: On Oct 12 Minter said Baltimore could designate Lane (wrist surgery) to return from IR as soon as Wednesday and did not rule him out for Week 6 at Cleveland. The Ravens waived WR Chris Moore, which opens a roster spot.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Roman Wilson (finger, multiple weeks) and Ben Skowronek (calf) were both hurt in Week 5, and McCarthy said Oct 12 that neither will play Oct 18 at Tampa Bay. That leaves the rookie Bernard as a top Steelers WR option and a widely recommended Week 6 waiver add.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: KC Concepcion entered the concussion protocol on Oct 12 and could miss Week 6 vs. Baltimore. Boston led the Browns with 8 targets and scored a TD in Week 5 and should see an even bigger role.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Stefon Diggs and Terry McLaurin both hurt, the rookie played 68% of snaps (3-3 receiving) in the Week 5 tie with the Giants on Oct 11. He could see more work while they're out, but has under 35 yards in each of his last four games.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: KC officially placed Tyquan Thornton (dislocated ankle, 3-4 months) on IR on Oct 13. Allen and Jalen Royals are expected to pick up more three-WR reps.

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Cleared the concussion protocol and played Week 5 at Miami on Oct 11, catching 6 of 10 targets for 77 yards and a TD. One CBS Week 6 tracker lists him as questionable with an illness, which is unconfirmed.

players.name: Dohnte Meyers
players.note: With Chase and Tee Higgins both back in Week 5 on Oct 11, Meyers fell to 19 snaps and 2 catches for 12 yards. His main value now is as a kick returner.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: On Oct 12 Kellen Moore said Tyson (hamstring, IR) is progressing but not on track to return to practice this week. A return after the Saints' Week 8 bye now looks more realistic.

players.name: Marvin Harrison
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 12:49 AM PT Oct 14.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Arizona traded Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston on Oct 11, 2026. Reports credited Wilson's emergence for pushing Harrison aside, and the trade locks Wilson in as the Cardinals' top outside receiver behind Trey McBride in the target pecking order.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.note: Houston added Marvin Harrison Jr. by trade on Oct 11, 2026, which adds competition for targets. Collins had only 2 catches for 45 yards in his Week 4 return from a hamstring injury.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.note: Nabers played through soreness in his surgically repaired knee in the Oct 11, 2026 27-27 tie at Washington and caught 11 of a career-high 20 targets for 121 yards and a TD. Only one fantasy-news source reports this line. The knee had kept him out of Wednesday practice that week.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey aggravated a foot injury in Week 4, missed every practice, and on Oct 11, 2026 was reported as not expected to play meaningful snaps vs. Denver. He has played under 50% of snaps in 3 of 4 games.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (finger) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: Wilson went to the locker room with a hand/wrist (finger) injury in Week 5 (Oct 11, 2026) and was ruled out for the rest of the game. No diagnosis has been reported yet.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:27 PM PT Oct 13. Earlier: ESPN reported on Oct 11, 2026 that Jefferson was expected to return from an ankle injury and play Week 5 at New Orleans after missing Week 4. He had been limited in practice all week.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson was ruled out with a concussion on the second play of the Oct 11 Week 5 win at New Orleans and entered the protocol. Minnesota has a bye in Week 6. Kevin O'Connell said Monday (Oct 12) that he's 'feeling pretty good', and analysts expect him back for Week 7 vs. the Colts on Oct 25.

DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley were both out, so he looks like Hurts' top short-term target heading into Week 6 vs. Carolina.
